base: finite two-current parent, not persistent continuation
single_intervention: Outer root ranking J(r)=S1_tag(r)+sum over original paths and tagged jobs of (start-birth)^2/tau_max. Fixed coefficient one; tau_max is the physical catalogue maximum frame duration. Original complete flow costs and flow-squared predictions remain separately recorded.
population: Original visible+tau_max prefix tagged population; later background births retain their original competition role. Original FIFO/native recourse is already correct; this is a new long-wait objective, not a missing-wait repair.
control: Ordinary BG incumbent and S2<=MW original-risk root membership remain unchanged. Strict J improvement and BG-first J ties. Exactly two frozen OLD-current calls then MW in each outer virtual continuation; same inner policies and all original stage overflow fallbacks.
future_arrival_input: Only current observed counts/exposure and original independent sampled paths. No realized future, selected-seed/root/class gate or mirror pairing.
development: Original24 literal tapes, four physical catalogues by two loads (.8,.95) by three shared seeds (41,42,43). Candidate applied continuously from time0 through observation1200; cohort300..900, environment births through1200, snapshots900/1200.
original_joint_gate: Inherited MW/BG joint gate unchanged, including >=1% pooled restricted mean improvement and original load/tail/unfinished bounds.
increment_gate: Versus finite_current: observation_end pooled restricted mean strictly improves; each load mean nonregresses; pooled common-ID P90 and pooled unfinished at both900 and1200 nonregress. Promotion requires both original joint gate and this parent increment gate.
work: Additional logical waiting subtraction, square, tau division and per-root penalty addition once per tagged admission; augmented score additions once per outer root. All actual parallel chunks, including discarded after first overflow, and child CPU are charged. No extra forecast/control calls or samples.
execution: CPU node001-node006;24 causal trajectories, with original root/two-sample chunks in per-trajectory process pools. Detailed trajectories stay on server; pull only small summaries.
limitations: Quadratic waiting changes the objective and can trade mean flow time against long waits. No performance gain follows from local score reduction. These are three shared development seeds; confirmation stays sealed.
